MUTT_PROJECT // CAPITOL LAB

Genetic engineering: nature as a weapon

  • Muttations (“mutts”): animals genetically modified by the Capitol
  • Built as weapons, in the war against the rebels and in the arenas
  • The Quell arena looks beautiful, but plants and animals are deadly
  • Jabberjays → mockingjays: a failed Capitol experiment that became the symbol of the rebellion
  • Watch out for where Katniss's mockingjay pin comes from
TodayCRISPR makes real gene editing possible. Who decides where the limits are?

Technology: the arena is a machine

  • Gamemakers control everything: weather, traps, day and night
  • The Capitol tracks and films every move the tributes make
  • Cameras, hovercraft and hidden mechanics everywhere
  • District 3 (Beetee, Wiress): tech experts who understand the system
  • Big question: can technology be turned against the Capitol?
TodaySmartphones, location data, surveillance cameras: we are tracked too.
LIVE
CAPITOL TV · THE 50TH HUNGER GAMES · SECOND QUARTER QUELL · 48 TRIBUTES · MANDATORY VIEWING FOR ALL DISTRICTS ·

Media: who holds the camera holds the power

  • Reaping, interviews and Games are broadcast live, and everyone must watch
  • Sponsors only help tributes who look good on screen
  • The Capitol edits the footage: what Panem sees isn't what really happened
  • A young Plutarch Heavensbee is filming District 12
